subject: PO fields, weekly invoicing option & prepay proposal
messages:
From: Tanya Levin <tanya.levin@blueharbor.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@blueharbor.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO format & invoicing cadence — weekly request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Procurement had a couple of follow-ups before we can issue a formal PO. Primary constraints from our side:

- PO must include explicit line-item SKUs, unit pricing, and the Redwood Agreement reference (we use the Redwood SOW number column).
- We require an invoice remit address and VAT/tax fields populated on the PO to map it into our ERP.
- Net terms: standard is Net45 for our vendors, but we can consider Net30 if there is a supplier discount.
- Invoice cadence: our payroll/ops team prefers weekly invoices for consumption billing to avoid month-end accruals.

Two asks we want to validate:
1) Will Redwood accept a weekly invoice cadence if the PO contains the full remit/ERP fields?
2) If weekly cadence is allowed, would Redwood require an upfront prepay or different pricing to offset faster cashflow?

We can attach our PO stub if that helps – I’ve attached a sample for clarity.

Thanks,
Tanya Levin
Senior Procurement Manager
BlueHarbor Systems

Attachments: blueharbor_po_stub.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Levin <tanya.levin@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO format & invoicing cadence — weekly request

Tanya — really appreciate the clarity here. Short answers up front: yes, we can support weekly invoices but we need the PO to include the ERP mapping fields you mentioned, and we’d ask for an agreed prepay to make weekly cadence economical on our side. Details below.

What we need on the PO to automate processing on our end:
- PO number, remit address, billing contact email, and tax/VAT id
- Line-item SKU (we map to model/route IDs), quantity, unit price, and expected monthly spend band
- Reference to Redwood SOW or acceptance criteria so Finance can tie invoices to the contract

Pricing/packaging options to support weekly invoices:
- Option A: No change to unit rates, 30% prepay at kickoff, remainder billed weekly on Net45 terms. This covers cashflow while keeping list prices intact.
- Option B: If BlueHarbor prefers zero prepay, we can move to Net30 and apply a 1.75% weekly-billing fee (applied as a line on invoices).
- Option C: For an annual committed volume (>= $500k ARR), we can convert to weekly invoices with no prepay and a 2% contract discount.

I’ve attached a Redwood PO template and the current pricing slab so your team can map SKUs. 

Next steps I propose:
1) You send back a BlueHarbor PO with the ERP fields filled in (we can quickly validate).
2) We loop Finance and Legal for a 30-minute alignment call to confirm prepay and discount language.
3) If acceptable, we’ll generate the DocuSign SOW amendment and a billing onboarding checklist.

Open question for Vanessa/Marissa: do we have any flex on the fee/discount mix for weekly invoicing for mid-size enterprise logos? I put some options above.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call tomorrow morning PT.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_po_template.xlsx (Excel, 12KB); pricing_slab_v3.pdf (PDF, 84KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: PO format & invoicing cadence — weekly request

Looping you both in. Quick thoughts from Finance:

- Weekly invoices increase AP overhead but are manageable with the prepay model.
- If we go zero-prepay with a fee, the fee should be a flat percent that scales down with commitment bands. Example: 1.75% fee for month-to-month, 1.25% fee for 6–11 month commits, 0.75% fee for annuals.
- For sales/discounting: we can offer a 1.5% discount off list in exchange for an annual commit with weekly billing (makes numbers attractive to procurement).

Marissa — can Legal draft a short SOW addendum that:
1) Allows weekly invoice cadence if PO includes ERP fields and remit address;
2) Captures the prepay % or the alternative fee schedule;
3) Preserves the baseline Net45 unless the fee/discount changes it.

If Legal needs precedent language I can share the last SOW amendment we used for a similar customer.

Vanessa
VP, Finance (pricing & ops)
Redwood Inference

Rishi/Vanessa/Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the options. BlueHarbor is prepared to move forward under the following conditionals: 

- We will issue a PO that includes the full ERP fields you requested and line-item SKUs; PO will reference the Redwood SOW number. Attached is our PO stub for your ingestion.
- We accept Option A (30% prepay, remainder weekly) on Net45 terms; we require a DocuSign SOW amendment to capture the prepay schedule and weekly cadence.
- Because we are a higher-touch integration, we request a one-time 0.5% implementation credit applied to the first monthly invoices.

Please send the DocuSign link for the SOW amendment and a final invoice onboarding checklist. Once Legal confirms the short addendum, we’ll issue the PO and route for signatures.

Thanks — looking forward to getting billing set up.

Best,
